nodes.name: Typebot Webhook
nodes.notes: Typebot ke 'Webhook' block me is URL ko paste karo (n8n webhook production URL). Trigger tab hoga jab visitor conversation complete karega.

nodes.name: Odoo - Create CRM Lead
nodes.notes: Odoo JSON-RPC via /jsonrpc endpoint. ODOO_UID = internal user id of the API user (get once via login RPC). Isse simpler alternative: Odoo Website Forms module already auto-creates leads for native forms - ye node sirf Typebot (external) leads ke liye zaroori hai.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO clients_master (odoo_lead_id, name, email, phone, company, service_type, intent_summary, urgency, source, status, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  {{$json.result.id}},
  {{JSON.stringify($('Parse Classification JSON').item.json.name)}},
  {{JSON.stringify($('Parse Classification JSON').item.json.email)}},
  {{JSON.stringify($('Parse Classification JSON').item.json.phone)}},
  {{JSON.stringify($('Parse Classification JSON').item.json.company)}},
  {{JSON.stringify($('Parse Classification JSON').item.json.service_type)}},
  {{JSON.stringify($('Parse Classification JSON').item.json.intent_summary)}},
  {{JSON.stringify($('Parse Classification JSON').item.json.urgency)}},
  'typebot_website_chat',
  'New',
  now(), now()
)
ON CONFLICT (odoo_lead_id) DO NOTHING;
